mainEntity.name: Do I need an appointment at Skin Trust Hospital Karur, or can I walk in?

acceptedAnswer.text: An appointment is strongly recommended as procedure days fill up quickly. The fastest way to book is WhatsApp at +91 90922 32991; you will usually be confirmed the same day.

mainEntity.name: Will Dr. Kavitha perform the procedure herself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Lasers, injectables, minor surgery and hair procedures are performed by Dr. Kavitha personally. Support staff assist with preparation and aftercare, not with the procedure itself.

mainEntity.name: Are these treatments safe for Indian skin?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, provided the settings are correct. Deeper skin types are more prone to post-inflammatory pigmentation, so device parameters, peel strengths and session gaps at Skin Trust are calibrated specifically for Tamil Nadu skin types.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions will I need for treatment at Skin Trust Hospital?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the concern. Hair PRP is typically a course over several months, acne scars usually need multiple combined sessions, laser hair removal takes 6-8 sittings, and a mole removal is often one visit. The expected number is given in writing at the consultation.

mainEntity.name: Does Skin Trust Hospital offer laser hair removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We use a medical-grade Diode Laser safe for all Indian skin types. Treatment areas include face, upper lip, underarms, arms, legs, bikini line and full body. Each session is performed by Dr. Kavitha.

mainEntity.name: Where is Skin Trust Hospital located in Karur?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. 28, Chairman Ramanujan Street, Karur 639001, opposite Kamaatchi Amman Temple, Tamil Nadu. Parking available directly outside.
